results.raw:
{
  "summary": "The patient presents with a new left-sided facial weakness, including reduced eyebrow raise, eye closure, lip movement, and smile. The left mouth corner moves more during eye closure, suggesting possible eye-to-mouth synkinesis. The weakness affects both upper and lower facial muscles, consistent with a peripheral facial nerve palsy pattern.",
  "weaker_side": "left",
  "possibilities": [
    {
      "condition": "Bell's palsy (idiopathic facial nerve palsy)",
      "why": "The patient has a new peripheral facial weakness pattern affecting both upper and lower face on the left, consistent with Bell's palsy.",
      "urgency": "urgent"
    },
    {
      "condition": "Exposure keratopathy risk (incomplete eye closure)",
      "why": "The patient's left eye does not close fully, increasing the risk of corneal exposure.",
      "urgency": "urgent"
    },
    {
      "condition": "Ramsay Hunt syndrome (herpes zoster oticus)",
      "why": "The patient has facial weakness and pain in or behind the ear, which can be associated with Ramsay Hunt syndrome.",
      "urgency": "urgent"
    },
    {
      "condition": "Post-paralytic synkinesis",
      "why": "The patient has possible eye-to-mouth synkinesis during eye closure, which can occur after facial nerve palsy.",
      "urgency": "routine"
    },
    {
      "condition": "Compressive lesion: acoustic neuroma, parotid tumour, cholesteatoma or skull base tumour",
      "why": "A peripheral pattern can sometimes be caused by a lesion compressing the facial nerve, although less common.",
      "urgency": "soon"
    }
  ],
